title: Dedicated Fleet Efficiency Guidance and Synthetic Load Profiles
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Produce a practical guidance engine and accompanying artifacts to help customers and SREs optimize dedicated GPU pools for cost and performance. We will deliver: (1) a tenant-level utilization report with percentile-based signatures and tail metrics; (2) a synthetic load profile generator to replay representative tail events and stress packing strategies; (3) an actionable sizing guidance API and web runbook that provides a recommended packing plan, conservative and aggressive commit suggestions, and estimated delta in token cost and latency percentiles. Scope excludes changes to autoscaler runtime itself — this ticket focuses on recommendations, reporting, and simulation artifacts that feed operator decisions and sales/CS conversations.
comments: 2026-02-10 Maya Chen: Kickoff — scoped deliverables after alignment with CS. Key success metrics: reduce unnecessary committed capacity by 12% for mid-market pools and avoid >1.5x latency regressions in 99th perc during workload spikes.

2026-02-18 Luca Moretti: Prototype synthetic load generator (python) created. Generator supports variable tenant mixes, burst windows, warm/cold KV cache scenarios. Initial runs against staging cluster show packing candidates that reduce idle GPU time by ~9% for sample workloads.

2026-02-24 Priya Nair (SRE): Trade-off note — aggressive packing increases scheduling churn that can impact cold-start latency for new tenants. We should present both conservative and aggressive suggestions with expected churn costs.

2026-03-01 Design review (Ava Singh): Dashboard mockups reviewed. Request: add an at-a-glance confidence band and a clear CTA to apply suggestions to a staging pool first. Also include sample commit change email template for CS.

2026-03-03 Performance tests: Ran 3-day synthetic replay against dedicated-staging. Observed 95th token latency preserved when using suggested packing with micro-burst smoothing. Edge-case: multi-tenant adversarial burst pattern exposes increased tail for very small tenants — added a tenant isolation flag to recommendations.

2026-03-05 Luca Moretti: Working on API endpoints (/v1/allocator/simulate, /v1/allocator/propose). Open PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/7892 — includes simulation CLI and basic UI integration. Requesting PM sign-off on rollout plan.
Pending: stakeholder review with Sales and CS scheduled 2026-03-08. Need cost-model review from Finance before enabling auto-apply in Console.
